description: A full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems via Agent Scan, Skills Scan, MCP scan, AI Infra scan and LLM jailbreak evaluation.

written.description: Gathers several separate AI security scans behind one console: the agent, the MCP servers, the skills, the serving infrastructure, and a jailbreak pass against the model itself.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(mcp-scan,skill-scan): stop reading a reply that only repeats closing tags (#769)

Some models keep emitting closing tags after a finished tool call until the server cuts the stream (~220k chars, minutes per reply), bloating history. Add has_runaway_tail / strip_runaway_tail and have LLM.chat_stream cut the stream once the tail is nearly pure closing tags (2400-char window, >=40 tags, <=40 non-tag slack), keeping the first </function> so the real call stays closed. Applied to mcp-scan and skill-scan; agent-scan unchanged.

Local validation (mcp-scan + skill-scan venvs, py3.11): new pytests/test_runaway_tail.py 31 passed in each; full mcp-scan 159 passed (2 pre-existing non-UTF8-filename failures also fail on main), skill-scan 195 passed. No regression.

Co-authored-by: hansenzhf <hansenzhf@users.noreply.github.com>
